# Integrating existing tools

ProjectOps integrates existing tools instead of replacing them.

## Principles

- One source of truth per artefact
- Link instead of copy
- Standardise minimal shared fields

## Example integrations

Jira + Confluence:
https://support.atlassian.com/

Azure DevOps:
https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/devops/

GitHub:
https://docs.github.com/

## Anti-patterns

- Migrating tools before improving practices
- Parallel tracking systems
